world.topic:
How fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa has been rising, from NOAA's own annual means.

Download NOAA GML's annual mean CO2 for Mauna Loa (https://gml.noaa.gov/webdata/ccgg/trends/co2/co2_annmean_mlo.csv) during the work; do not type the numbers in. Keep the file as downloaded, with its URL, the time it was fetched and its SHA-256.

Fit the annual means from 1960 on with a straight line and with a quadratic in the year, and give the growth rate in ppm per year for the 1960s and for the last ten years in the file, each with a 95% interval from the quadratic fit.

Report: `report/report.md`, half a page: where the data came from (URL, fetch time, SHA-256, last year in the file), both fits, the two growth rates with their intervals, and one figure of the data with both fits.
